top_stories.title: Impersonating IT support: how threat actors turn a remote session into enterprise-wide access
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence documented a human-operated attack campaign that exploits Microsoft Teams external collaboration features to impersonate IT support and gain unauthorized remote access to enterprise systems. Attackers use social engineering through Teams to establish remote sessions, then deploy a Node.js-based implant to achieve persistent enterprise-wide access.

top_stories.title: New identity governance and access features in Microsoft Entra
top_stories.summary: Microsoft released multiple generally available and preview updates to Microsoft Entra in September 2026, covering identity governance and access management features. The updates include tenant governance, user-centric access reviews, lifecycle workflow management, passwordless Teams device identities, and hybrid identity improvements.

top_stories.title: Attackers Pounce on Critical Artifactory Bug Following Disclosure
top_stories.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-82329) has been disclosed in JFrog Artifactory, allowing attackers to gain admin-level access on affected systems. Attackers are actively exploiting the flaw following its public disclosure.

top_stories.title: Your Employee’s Password Appeared in an Infostealer Log. Now What?
top_stories.summary: Flare published guidance on responding to employee credentials appearing in infostealer logs, covering risks beyond passwords such as stolen authenticated sessions that can bypass MFA. The article outlines how defenders can prioritize compromised identities and assess whether stolen access tokens remain valid to prevent account takeover.

top_stories.title: Hackers exploit critical JFrog Artifactory flaw to forge admin tokens
top_stories.summary: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-82329) in JFrog Artifactory is being actively exploited to forge administrative tokens. The flaw allows attackers to bypass authentication and create tokens with administrative access to Artifactory instances.

news.title: A five-part inventory for your AI agent credentials
news.summary: Orchid co-founder and CEO Roy Katmor presents a framework for inventorying AI agent credentials, highlighting that agents built in AI studios receive accounts and access to enterprise tools that fall outside standard identity review processes. The video walks through a specific onboarding agent with access to HR, identity provider, ticketing, and payroll systems as a case study for unmanaged non-human identities.

news.title: New infosec products of the week: September 4, 2026
news.summary: A weekly infosec product roundup features releases from BugBase, F5 Networks, Ping Identity, and Superna. The Ping Identity inclusion makes this marginally relevant to IAM professionals, though the article is a broad multi-vendor roundup with limited detail on Ping Identity's specific release.

news.title: Thomson Reuters Court Software Breach May Have Exposed SSNs and Sealed Data
news.summary: Thomson Reuters disclosed that an unauthorized party obtained files from C-Track, its West Publishing court case management platform, in March 2026, affecting courts in 11 U.S. states, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Ontario, Canada. The breach potentially exposed sensitive personal data including Social Security Numbers and sealed court records.

news.title: Shai-Hulud's Reach Just Grew to 469 Credential Locations. Here's What That Means
news.summary: GitGuardian researchers discovered that a Shai-Hulud infostealer worm variant has expanded its credential-stealing capability from 189 to 469 locations, targeting developer environments, CI/CD tooling, cloud configurations, and AI tool configs. The expansion demonstrates a significant escalation in credential harvesting scope across identity-sensitive infrastructure components.

news.title: Researcher Releases FalconFlank PoC Showing Privilege Escalation in CrowdStrike Falcon
news.summary: A security researcher released a proof-of-concept exploit called FalconFlank demonstrating a zero-day privilege escalation vulnerability in CrowdStrike Falcon. The flaw abuses the office malicious macros remediation feature in CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor to achieve privilege escalation.

news.title: Back to the Future: Why Agentic AI Needs a Strong Identity Foundation
news.summary: The article examines the identity infrastructure requirements for agentic AI deployments in enterprise environments. It addresses how AI agents require robust identity foundations to manage authentication, authorization, and access controls as autonomous systems interact with applications and services.

news.title: Old, Unpatched Flaws Give Attackers Access to Philippines Nuclear Agency
news.summary: Threat actors exploited unpatched vulnerabilities in ownCloud to breach the Philippines Nuclear Agency, stealing credential stores among other sensitive data. The attack leveraged commodity vulnerabilities to gain initial access, resulting in the compromise of personnel records and reactor databases.

news.title: Attackers Exploit Two SonicWall SMA 1000 Zero-Days That May Form an Attack Chain
news.summary: SonicWall has released security updates addressing two zero-day vulnerabilities in its Secure Mobile Access (SMA) 1000 series VPN appliances, including a pre-authentication SSRF flaw rated CVSS 10.0. The vulnerabilities, which may form an attack chain, have been actively exploited and affect remote access infrastructure commonly used in enterprise environments.

news.title: A Beginner's Deep Dive Guide to Entra Passkeys
news.summary: The article provides a deep-dive guide to implementing passkeys in Microsoft Entra as a phishing-resistant authentication method. It covers passkey configuration and setup within the Entra identity platform as an alternative to traditional passwords.

news.title: Okta Stock Has More Than Doubled in 2026. AI Agents Could Drive the Next Leg Higher
news.summary: Okta stock has more than doubled in 2026, with analysts pointing to AI agent identity management as a key growth driver. The article focuses on Okta's market position in securing AI agents as businesses increasingly deploy autonomous digital workers requiring identity and access controls.

news.title: Gartner named SafePaaS in the 2026 Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) for cybersecurity leaders facing growing threats from AI agents
news.summary: SafePaaS has been named a Representative Vendor in the 2026 Gartner Market Guide for Identity Governance and Administration (IGA). The recognition positions SafePaaS within the IGA market landscape, with the guide addressing growing cybersecurity threats from AI agents.

news.title: Cloudflare Adds Optional OAuth Scopes, Letting Developers Mark What Users May Decline
news.summary: Cloudflare has introduced optional OAuth scopes, allowing developers to designate which permissions users can deselect during the consent flow. The feature was motivated by MCP (Model Context Protocol) server use cases where agents request broad permission sets that users may not fully need to grant.

news.title: OpenID Connect Authentication for MySQL, Now Fully Open Source
news.summary: Percona Server for MySQL has released a fully open source OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication plugin, available starting with versions 8.4.11-11 and 9.7.2-2. The plugin allows MySQL accounts to authenticate against an OIDC-compliant identity provider, enabling federated identity and SSO capabilities for database access.

news.title: Attackers Exploit Critical JFrog Artifactory Flaw to Mint Admin Tokens Days After Disclosure
news.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting CVE-2026-82329, a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in JFrog Artifactory, within days of its public disclosure. The flaw allows attackers to bypass authentication and gain administrative access, enabling the minting of admin tokens in affected Artifactory instances.

news.title: Threat Actors Don’t Want Better Attacks. They Want Repeatable Ones
news.summary: Microsoft's threat intelligence team identified ClickFix as the most common initial access method observed last year, where attackers manipulate users into executing malicious clipboard commands via social engineering rather than exploiting technical vulnerabilities. The technique bypasses traditional security controls by targeting human behavior during authentication or verification interactions, representing a shift toward repeatable, low-sophistication credential and access compromise methods.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web identity theft service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian driver's licenses, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official investigation into the breach, which affects a widely-used identity verification provider.

news.title: Anthropic Users Hit by Infostealer Attacks, Session Thefts
news.summary: A threat actor deployed infostealer malware to steal session tokens and gain unauthorized access to Claude (Anthropic) user accounts. The attack involved session hijacking techniques to bypass authentication on compromised accounts.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian hacker Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to breaching over 165 organizations using cloud data storage provider Snowflake. The attacks exploited stolen credentials to access Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in data theft including over 100 million AT&T customer records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA published a postmortem after a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secret scanning and response procedures relevant to IAM and secrets management practices.
